recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-22752 unless a future work group issue revisits the Modules page wording.
issue_request: FHIR-22752 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction from fhir-i asking that the first sentence on the Modules page say that FHIR defines capabilities 'for use across the healthcare process' instead of the ungrammatical 'capabilities use across the healthcare process'.
initial_application: Jira records the fix in merge commit b30699596f4ad973437492684c4c7cf9365dbcff. Its source-changing commit ba6c0f397d4671610cf62a336e1eae3f17b3a10a updated source/modules.html from 'capabilities used across' to 'capabilities for use across', and that commit is an ancestor of the current source.
additional_context: FHIR-31701 was an earlier Published/Persuasive typo correction for the same sentence that changed 'capabilities use' to 'capabilities used'. It is already represented on the combined branch by commit 567eba849b5795f18fa68325432fba84624dd9be, so it was treated as related context rather than republished. Build-scope checks show modules.html is listed in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml as the Getting Started page. Community checks found no relevant Zulip discussion and no Confluence evidence changing the conclusion; the only Confluence Jira reference found was an unrelated minutes item.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/modules.html text already reads 'FHIR is a platform specification that defines a set of capabilities for use across the healthcare process,' matching the requested correction.

related_jiras.note: Earlier same-sentence typo correction changed 'capabilities use' to 'capabilities used'; already audited on the combined branch and not duplicated here.
